name: svg-basestation
description: Basestation panel for the SVG counter-UAS swarm: sim/real agent wiring, a two-click land-all safety stop, link safety (ping, mocap state-estimate delay, EKF status, packet drop), 4G/5G Tailscale VPN latency, and per-agent battery & RTB power management. Sections appear only when their topics are being published.
